paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 115b, asking a question of Rav Nachman.

notes.text: The notice cites Shabbat 146b for Rav Huna bar Chalov asking Rav Nachman. That name and exchange were not found in the saved William Davidson digital text of that folio. It ends with Rav Huna’s name introducing the teaching about shaking a cloak, which continues on 147a. The supplied citation remains unresolved; this is not proof of absence from other editions.

The supplied Hebrew transcription reads קמו:, Shabbat 146b. Hyman’s printed notice (vol. I, p. 351) reads קטו:, Shabbat 115b. At 115b Rav Huna bar Chalov asks Rav Nachman about rescuing a Torah scroll with fewer than eighty-five letters. Hyman’s adjacent entry on bar Halvon cites a different episode in Shabbat 139b, where the consulted text gives Chayon and Halvon as alternate names.
